{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module DNSResolver where

import System.IO
import System.Directory
import System.FilePath
import System.Posix.Files
import System.Posix.Temp
import Control.Exception
import Control.Monad
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isSuffixOf)
import Data.Char (toLower)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import Network.DNS
import Data.IORef
import System.Posix.Types (FileMode)

-- Configuration for the resolver cache
data ResolverConfig = ResolverConfig
  { cacheDir      :: FilePath
  , maxUploadSize :: Int
  , allowedZones  :: [String]
  }

defaultConfig :: ResolverConfig
defaultConfig = ResolverConfig
  { cacheDir      = "/var/cache/dnsresolver"
  , maxUploadSize = 65536
  , allowedZones  = [".example.com", ".internal.local"]
  }

-- Validate that a domain belongs to allowed zones
validateDomain :: ResolverConfig -> String -> Bool
validateDomain cfg domain =
  let normalized = map toLower domain
  in any (\zone -> zone `isSuffixOf` normalized) (allowedZones cfg)

-- Parse a zone file upload into individual records
parseZoneRecords :: BS.ByteString -> [(String, String)]
parseZoneRecords content =
  let lines' = C8.lines content
      parseLine l = case C8.words l of
        (name:_typ:value:_) -> Just (C8.unpack name, C8.unpack value)
        _ -> Nothing
  in concatMap (maybe [] (:[]) . parseLine) lines'

-- Atomically write cache entry using temporary file
-- Uses mkstemp for secure temp file creation then atomic rename
writeCacheEntry :: ResolverConfig -> String -> BS.ByteString -> IO FilePath
writeCacheEntry cfg domain content = do
  let targetDir = cacheDir cfg
  createDirectoryIfMissing True targetDir
  -- Create temp file securely using mkstemp (unpredictable name, exclusive create)
  let template = targetDir </> "dns_cache_XXXXXX"
  (tmpPath, tmpHandle) <- mkstemp template
  -- Write content through the handle (file already opened exclusively)
  BS.hPut tmpHandle content
  hClose tmpHandle
  -- Set restrictive permissions on temp file
  setFileMode tmpPath restrictedMode
  -- Atomic rename to final location
  let finalPath = targetDir </> sanitizeFilename domain
  renameFile tmpPath finalPath
  return finalPath

-- Restricted file mode: owner read/write only
restrictedMode :: FileMode
restrictedMode = ownerReadMode `unionFileModes` ownerWriteMode

-- Sanitize filename to prevent path traversal
sanitizeFilename :: String -> String
sanitizeFilename input =
  let stripped = takeFileName input  -- removes any directory components
      cleaned = map (\c -> if c `elem` ['\0'] then '_' else c) stripped
  in if null cleaned then "_invalid_" else cleaned

-- Process an uploaded zone file from untrusted source
processUpload :: ResolverConfig -> String -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String [FilePath])
processUpload cfg clientId rawContent = do
  -- Size validation
  when (BS.length rawContent > maxUploadSize cfg) $
    throwIO $ userError "Upload exceeds maximum size"
  
  let records = parseZoneRecords rawContent
  
  -- Validate all domains
  let invalidDomains = filter (not . validateDomain cfg . fst) records
  if not (null invalidDomains)
    then return $ Left $ "Invalid domains: " ++ show (map fst invalidDomains)
    else do
      -- Write each record to cache
      paths <- forM records $ \(domain, value) -> do
        let encoded = C8.pack $ domain ++ " IN A " ++ value
        writeCacheEntry cfg domain encoded
      return $ Right paths

-- Resolve a domain using cached entries
resolveCached :: ResolverConfig -> String -> IO (Maybe BS.ByteString)
resolveCached cfg domain = do
  let path = cacheDir cfg </> sanitizeFilename domain
  exists <- doesFileExist path
  if exists
    then Just <$> BS.readFile path
    else return Nothing

-- Cleanup expired cache entries
cleanupCache :: ResolverConfig -> Int -> IO ()
cleanupCache cfg maxAgeSecs = do
  let dir = cacheDir cfg
  entries <- listDirectory dir
  forM_ entries $ \entry -> do
    let fullPath = dir </> entry
    isFile <- doesFileExist fullPath
    when isFile $ do
      status <- getFileStatus fullPath
      let age = 0 -- simplified: would compute from modificationTime
      when (age > maxAgeSecs) $
        removeFile fullPath

-- Main resolver loop entry point
runResolver :: ResolverConfig -> IO ()
runResolver cfg = do
  putStrLn $ "DNS Resolver starting with cache at: " ++ cacheDir cfg
  createDirectoryIfMissing True (cacheDir cfg)
  -- Set directory permissions - owner only
  setFileMode (cacheDir cfg) ownerModes
  putStrLn "Resolver ready for uploads"
